description: This file defines the GestureTypingPathDrawHelper class, which implements gesture path drawing and touch event handling for gesture typing in the keyboard app. It manages drawing lines between touch points and handles touch events to update the gesture trail.

classes.name: GestureTypingPathDrawHelper
classes.description: A helper class for drawing gesture typing paths, handling touch events, and rendering gesture trails on a canvas.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of GestureTypingPathDraw, returning a no-op implementation if the theme's max trail length is non-positive.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Draws the gesture trail on the provided Canvas by connecting the sequence of touch points.

methods.name: handleTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles MotionEvent input to update the gesture trail points based on user touch interactions.
